column1: # p235 — THE REGISTRY LIMB. repos/trending.md publishes "LATAM in the registry: zero" and p232 opened
# the PACKAGE REGISTRY channel specifically to find rows the repository harvester could not see.
# Three live LATAM education packages were on that channel the whole time, all MIT, all updated
# 2026-10-15 — the day BEFORE this pass, and inside p232's own window. The npm names are NOT guessable:
# four guessed names (bncc, @bncc/bncc, bncc-dados, @bncc-dev/bncc) all 404. The real names came from
# packages/bncc/package.json in the repo. p233's rule holds: a 404 on a GUESSED name is not an absence.
